name: Evocation Adept

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: always prepare these spells when you have slots of levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively: Chromatic Orb; Shatter; Fireball; Vitriolic Sphere; Wall of Force. Reference-only: Once per turn when an Evocation deals damage on casting, roll and spend up to two unused Hit Dice, adding their total to one damage roll.
